blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Users often complain that AI assistants such as ChatGPT are getting worse. Some versions do change, but human evaluation leaves a second possibility untested: the people judging may change. We separate the two on Chatbot Arena, a public platform where people compare answers from two anonymous large language models (LLMs) and pick the better one or say both are bad. We study 1,260,967 blind votes cast from May 2023 to August 2024 on pairs of models whose versions are fixed: dated vendor snapshots and models with fixed open weights. For the same pair of unchanged models, the share of votes saying "both are bad" rises by 1.71 percentage points a month on a mean of 17.1%, and by 1.91 points a month in 2024. In fourteen pairs observed often in both 2023 and 2024, it rose in every one, from 15.5% to 23.3%. The ranking does not trend: in 2024, the stronger model's share of decisive votes is flat. The rise holds within the same voter and on the same pair, and across arrival cohorts from their first recorded vote. It holds with prompt controls, in every major language, for dated vendor snapshots, open-weight models and models with stable answer length, and between interface changes. The drift is shared across models: month effects estimated from other models' pairs remove it from each model's own pairs. Platform-wide, the average model would be expected to score 78% against the 2023 average, yet the share of "both are bad" votes ended near where it began. The pattern fits a standard that follows the category's progress, so a product that stands still is judged as declining. Absolute verdicts on AI drifted while relative comparisons held steady, an evaluation drift that matters for LLM leaderboards and for the human feedback used to train models.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Complaints that an AI assistant “got dumber” have followed almost every widely used large language model (LLM). Users say a model has become lazy, that it refuses more, that its answers have lost their edge. These complaints matter. They feed public debate about whether AI progress has stalled, they shape whether people keep paying for a service, and they are often read as evidence that a provider quietly changed its product. Sometimes the product did change. Chen et al. (2024) show that the March and June 2023 versions of the model behind ChatGPT behaved differently on several tasks, so a model offered under the same name can change underneath its users.
blocks.zh: 关于大赦国际助理“笨手笨脚的”几乎每一个广泛使用的大型语言模型(LLM)都使用的投诉。 用户说,一个模型变得懒惰了,它拒绝了更多的,它的答案失去了他们的优势. 这些申诉都很重要。 他们为公众讨论AI的进步是否停滞不前,他们决定人们是否继续支付服务费,他们经常被解读为提供者悄悄地改变其产品的证据. 有时产品确实变了 Chen等 (2024)显示,ChatGPT背后的2023年3月和6月版本的模型在几个任务上表现不同,因此同名提供的一个模型可以在用户下方改变.

blocks.en: A complaint, however, is a comparison between what a person receives and what the person expected. If expectations rise, an answer that once satisfied will disappoint even if nothing about it has changed. This comparison lies at the core of the expectation-confirmation account of satisfaction with information systems ( Oliver, 1980 ; Bhattacherjee, 2001 ) , and adaptation-level theory in psychology makes the same point: judgments are made against a reference that drifts toward recent experience ( Helson, 1964 ; Brickman and Campbell, 1971 ; Frederick and Loewenstein, 1999 ) . Generative AI is an extreme case for such drift. Better models arrived every few months between 2023 and 2024, and many people used several of them. If each new model raised the bar, people would judge yesterday’s AI more harshly even when yesterday’s AI had not changed at all.
blocks.zh: 然而,申诉是个人收到的物品和预期物品之间的比较。 如果人们的期望增加,一个一旦得到满足的答案即使没有改变,也会令人失望。 这种比较是期望-确认对信息系统满意的叙述(Oliver,1980年;Bhattacherjee,2001年)的核心,心理学中的适应层面理论也提出了同样的观点:根据一种转向最近经验的提法(Helson,1964年;Brickman和Campbell,1971年;Frederick和Loewenstein,1999年)作出判断。 遗传 大赦国际是这种漂移的极端例子。 2023至2024年间每几个月有更好的模型到达,许多人使用过其中数个. 即使昨天的AI完全没有改变,

blocks.en: The two explanations, a declining product and rising standards, predict the same complaints, and in ordinary use they are hard to separate. The model behind a product name can change, the people complaining change, and the questions people ask change as they learn what AI can do. Separating them requires the same unchanged product, judged repeatedly over a long period, by people who do not know which product they are judging, with each verdict recorded as it is made.
blocks.zh: 两种解释,一种是产品下降而标准提高,预测同样的抱怨,在一般使用中很难分开. 一个产品名称背后的模型可以改变,人们抱怨改变,人们在学会AI能做什么时会问改变. 分离它们需要同样不变的产品,在很长一段时间内,由不知道自己在判断哪一种产品的人反复判断,每个判决都记录下来。

blocks.en: The distinction matters for decisions that organizations make from human evaluations of AI. Providers watch user ratings for signs that a release has regressed and decide what to change. Buyers choose models from public leaderboards built on human votes. Developers train models on human judgments of which answers are acceptable. Each of these decisions reads a fall in human ratings as information about the system. If the evaluators’ standard moves, the same data mislead: a stable product looks like a regressing one, and labels collected in different periods encode different standards.
blocks.zh: 各组织对大赦国际的人类评价所作决定的区别很重要。 供应商观看用户的评级,以发现发布后出现倒退的迹象,并决定要改变什么。 买家从基于人票的公共领导板上选择模型. 开发者就人类判断的模型进行培训,这些模型的答案是可以接受的. 这些决定都把人类评级的下降看成是系统的信息. 如果评价者的标准动作,同样的数据会误导:稳定的产品看起来就像一个倒退的产品,在不同时期收集的标签编码了不同的标准。

blocks.en: Existing theory offers competing answers to where such a decline comes from. Expectation-confirmation research explains evaluations through expectations that users form and revise by using the focal system ( Bhattacherjee, 2001 ; Bhattacherjee and Premkumar, 2004 ) . Research on online ratings attributes the decline of a fixed product’s ratings to changes in who rates ( Li and Hitt, 2008 ; Godes and Silva, 2012 ) . Adaptation-level theory predicts instead that each rater’s reference rises with experience across a category ( Helson, 1964 ) . These accounts locate the decline in different places, and they have not been compared in a setting that holds the system fixed, keeps the evaluation blind and follows the same raters over time. We ask three research questions. First, do human evaluations of unchanged AI systems become harsher over time? Second, does the change sit in absolute or in relative judgments, and in the raters themselves or in the composition of the rater pool? Third, can an evaluation system remove the change, and how?
blocks.zh: 现有理论为这种下降的根源提供了相互竞争的答案。 Bhattacherjee,2001年;Bhattacherjee和Premkumar,2004年)。 关于在线评级的研究将固定产品评级的下降归因于谁评级的变化(Li and Hitt, 2008; Godes and Silva, 2012.). 相反,适应级理论预测,每个评估者的参考值随着一个类别的经验而上升(Helson,1964年)。 这些账户在不同的地方找到下降点,没有在固定系统、保持评价盲点和随时间推移遵循同一评级的环境下对其进行比较。 我们提出三个研究问题。 首先,人类对没有改变的人工智能系统的评价是否随着时间的推移变得更加严厉? 第二,这种变化是绝对的还是相对的判断,还是衡量者本身的,还是衡量者池的组成? 第三,评价系统能否去除变化?

blocks.en: Chatbot Arena provides such a setting ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Chiang et al., 2024 ) . On Arena, a person writes a prompt, receives answers from two anonymous models side by side, and votes: the left answer is better, the right answer is better, it is a tie, or both are bad. Model names are revealed only after the vote. Many of the models Arena served were fixed versions: dated snapshots that vendors publish as unchanging (such as gpt-4-0314 ) and models whose open weights are fixed. Pairs of unchanged models therefore met the public blind, again and again, and the overlapping pairs span more than a year. We study the 1,260,967 votes cast on such pairs from May 2023 to August 2024 and ask whether verdicts on the same unchanged models changed over time. Holding the pair of models fixed, a change in verdicts must come from the people judging, from the prompts they write, or from the platform. We test each of these in turn.

blocks.en: The answer to the first question is that people became steadily harsher. We report six findings, which answer the three questions in turn. 1. Same models, harsher verdicts. Within the same pair of frozen models, the share of votes saying “both are bad” rises by 1.71 percentage points a month (SE 0.18) on a mean of 17.1 %, and by 1.91 points a month in 2024, when the data are densest. In the fourteen pairs observed often in both 2023 and 2024, the share rose in every pair, from 15.5 % to 23.3 %. 2. The bar moves, not the ranking. The extra “both are bad” votes come out of decisive votes; ties do not change. In 2024, when most votes were cast, the stronger model’s share of decisive votes shows no trend (0.00 points a month, SE 0.13) while “both are bad” rises by 1.91. What changes is how often neither answer is acceptable, not which answer is preferred. 3. Not the prompts, the models or the interface. The rise holds with controls for prompt language, content, difficulty tags and conversation, in single-turn conversations, on easy English prompts and in each of the seven most common languages. It holds for pairs of dated OpenAI and Anthropic snapshots, of open-weight models and of models with stable answer length, and within the periods between changes to Arena’s interface. These measured changes do not account for it. 4. People become pickier. The rise appears within the same voter over time ( + + 1.90 points a month among 24,508 judge identifiers seen over at least a month) and within the same voter on the same pair ( + + 2.30, with identifier-by-pair fixed effects). It also appears across arrival cohorts: a voter arriving in 2024 judges the same frozen pair more harshly on their first recorded vote than a voter who arrived in 2023 ( + + 1.25 points per month of arrival date). 5. No momentary contrast. The strength of the models a voter happened to see in their previous battle, which the platform draws for them, does not make their next verdict harsher. 6. A shared drift that frozen references remove. Seventeen of eighteen frequently judged frozen models show a significant rise in “both are bad” on their own pairs. Month effects estimated only from other models’ pairs remove it: the average trend falls from + + 1.40 to + + 0.19 points a month. On the platform as a whole, the pattern resembles a treadmill. A model drawn from the August 2024 battles would be expected to score about 78 % against one drawn from May 2023, yet the share of “both are bad” votes across all battles was 19.4 % in May 2023 and 20.6 % in August 2024.

blocks.en: These results make three contributions. First, they show that evaluations of an information system can decline while the system stays fixed, through a change located in the evaluators. Continuance research models expectations about a system and how they change with use of that system ( Bhattacherjee, 2001 ; Bhattacherjee and Premkumar, 2004 ; Kim and Malhotra, 2005 ) . We observe evaluations of systems that never changed becoming harsher as the rest of their category improved, within the same voters and for newcomers from their first recorded vote. Adaptation-level theory explains this pattern with a reference point formed across the category rather than by the focal system ( Helson, 1964 ) .
blocks.zh: 这些成果有三项贡献。 首先,它们表明,在信息系统保持不变期间,通过评价人员的变化,对信息系统的评价可能会下降。 持续研究模型对一个系统的期望及其如何随着该系统的使用而变化(Bhattacherjee,2001年;Bhattacherjee和Premkumar,2004年;Kim和Malhotra,2005年)。 我们观察到,对同一类选民内部和新来者第一次有记录的投票之后,随着其他类别的选举得到改善,这些制度从未改变过。 适应级理论用一个跨类别而不是由联络系统形成的参考点来解释这种模式(Helson,1964年)。

blocks.en: Second, the results identify a rater-side mechanism behind declining ratings. Online ratings for the same product tend to fall over time, and prior work attributes the decline to changes in who rates: early buyers like a product more than later ones, and later reviewers react to earlier reviews ( Li and Hitt, 2008 ; Godes and Silva, 2012 ; Moe and Schweidel, 2012 ) . Because Arena holds the product fixed and lets us follow the same voter, it shows that the same voter becomes harsher, so even a stable pool of raters would produce declining scores for an unchanged product.
blocks.zh: 第二,结果确定了评级下降背后的评级方机制。 同一产品的在线收视率往往随时间推移而下降,而前作将收视率的下降归因于谁的收视率的变化:早期买家喜欢产品比后作多,后作审查者对更早的收视(Li and Hitt, 2008; Godes and Silva, 2012; Moe and Schweidel, 2012. 因为阿雷纳持有产品固定,让我们跟随同一个选民,这表明同一个选民变得更加苛刻,所以即使是稳定的一批评分者也会为一个不变的产品产生递减分.

blocks.en: Third, the results inform the design of evaluation systems. Comparative judgments are known to be more stable than absolute ones ( Thurstone, 1927 ; Parducci, 1965 ; Stewart et al., 2005 ) , and rating scales drift in their meaning ( Garg and Johari, 2021 ; Filippas et al., 2022 ) . Human-preference platforms and the human feedback used to train LLMs mix both kinds of judgment ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Chiang et al., 2024 ) . On Arena, the absolute part drifted at an annualized rate of about 21 points while the relative part showed no trend in 2024, so an absolute label collected in 2023 does not mean what the same label means in 2024. Because the drift is shared across models, frozen reference pairs judged in the same period can re-anchor absolute verdicts, and we show that this works out of sample.
blocks.zh: 第三,评价结果为评价系统的设计提供了依据。 比较判断已知比绝对判断更稳定(Thurstone,1927;Parducci,1965;Stewart等,2005;),其含义的评级浮动(Garg和Johari,2021;Filippas等,2022.). 用于训练LLMS的人类偏好平台和人类反馈混合了两种判断(Christiano等,2017;Ouyang等,2022;Chiang等,2024.). 在阿雷纳,绝对部分以约21分的年化速率漂移,而相对部分在2024年显示没有趋势,因此2023年所收集的绝对标签并不意味着2024年同一标签的含义. 因为漂移是跨模型共享的,在同一时期判断的被冻结的参考对可以重新确定绝对的判断,我们显示这在样本之外是可行的.

blocks.en: For practice, the results caution against reading complaints about AI decline at face value: an AI product that stands still will be judged as getting worse. For evaluation platforms, absolute verdicts should be time-stamped and re-anchored against frozen references, and comparisons across periods should rest on relative judgments or on fixed reference items.
blocks.zh: 在实践中,结果告诫不要读取有关AI下降的表面价值的投诉:仍然站着的AI产品将被评为越来越差. 就评价平台而言,绝对判决应加时标并对照被冻结的参考文献重新确定,跨期间的比较应取决于相对判断或固定参考项目。

blocks.en: The rest of the paper proceeds as follows. Section 2 develops the framework and hypotheses. Section 3 describes Arena and the data, Section 4 the empirical approach, and Section 5 the results. Section 6 discusses implications, limitations and future work, and Section 7 concludes.
blocks.zh: 其余的论文如下. 第2节发展了框架和假设。 第3节介绍阿雷纳和数据,第4节介绍经验方法,第5节介绍结果。 第6节讨论了所涉问题、局限性和今后的工作,第7节结束。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 2 背景和假设

blocks.en: 2.1 Does the model change, or does the judge?
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 模特儿变了还是法官变了?

blocks.en: When users say an AI system has become worse, two kinds of change could be responsible. The first is a change in the system. Hosted LLMs are updated behind stable product names, and Chen et al. (2024) document large differences in behaviour between two versions of the same named service released three months apart. The second is a change in the person. The same output can be judged differently if the standard the person applies has moved.
blocks.zh: 当用户说AI系统变得更糟时,两种变化可能要负责. 第一是系统的变化。 Hosted LLMS在稳定产品名称后更新,而Chen等. (2024)记录了两个版本的同名服务在行为上的巨大差异,分别发布了3个月. 二是人身变化. 如果个人应用的标准被移动,同样的输出可以被不同的判断.

blocks.en: Evidence on the first kind of change is growing. Evidence on the second is scarce, because most data on how people judge AI come from a single moment, from changing systems, or from people who know which system they are using. Human-preference data are nonetheless central to how AI is built and compared. Preference comparisons train models through reinforcement learning from human feedback ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , and public leaderboards rank models by aggregating crowdsourced comparisons ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Chiang et al., 2024 ) . Recent work shows that these rankings are sensitive to which models are sampled and how ( Singh et al., 2025 ) , and that dropping a handful of preferences can change which model ranks first ( Huang et al., 2026 ) . Singh et al. (2025) also argue that, as prompts shift and models are retired, historical pairwise comparisons cease to represent present-day performance. Their concern is a changing mix of prompts and models. Whether the judges themselves change, so that the same comparison would receive a different verdict later, has not been examined.
blocks.zh: 第一种变化的证据越来越多。 关于第二个系统的证据很少,因为大多数关于人们如何判断AI的数据来自一个单一的时刻,来自变化中的系统,或来自知道他们使用的系统的人. 然而,人类偏好数据对于人工智能的构建和比较至关重要。 通过从人类反馈中强化学习来进行优先比较的列车模型(Christiano等,2017;Ouyang等,2022;公共领跑板通过汇总众源比较来排名模型(郑等,2023;蒋等,2024. 最近的工作表明,这些排名对哪些模型被取样以及如何取样十分敏感(Singh等人,2025年),放弃少数偏好可以改变哪个模型排在首位(Huang等人,2026年)。 Singh等人(2025年)也认为,随着转动和模型的退役,历史的对等比较不再代表当今的性能. 他们的关切是各种提示和模式的不断变化。 法官本身是否发生变化,以便同一比较日后得到不同的判决,尚未审查。

blocks.en: 2.2 Reference-dependent evaluation of information systems
blocks.zh: 2.2 信息系统的参考性评价

blocks.en: Our framework is reference-dependent evaluation: a person judges an outcome against a reference, and the reference moves with experience. In information systems research, the best-known version is expectation-confirmation theory. Satisfaction depends on how performance compares with prior expectations ( Oliver, 1980 ) , and users whose expectations are confirmed keep using a system ( Bhattacherjee, 2001 ) . Longitudinal work shows that beliefs and attitudes about a system change after adoption as users gain experience with it ( Bhattacherjee and Premkumar, 2004 ; Kim and Malhotra, 2005 ) , and the comparison is asymmetric: quality that falls short of expectations weighs more heavily than quality that exceeds them ( Anderson and Sullivan, 1993 ) . Empirical continuance studies measure expectations about the focal system and follow how they change with use of that system. Whether progress elsewhere in a product category moves the standard applied to a fixed system has rarely been tested with field data.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架是参照性评价:一个人根据参照性评价结果,参照性随经验而变化。 在信息系统研究中,最出名的版本是期望-确认理论. 满意程度取决于业绩如何与以前的预期相比较(Oliver,1980年),以及预期得到确认的用户继续使用一个系统(Bhatacherjee,2001年)。 纵向工作显示,随着用户获得使用系统的经验,对系统改变的信念和态度(Bhatacherjee和Premkumar,2004年;Kim和Malhotra,2005年),这种比较是不对称的:低于预期的质量比超过预期的质量重(Anderson和Sullivan,1993年)。 经验性持续研究衡量了对协调中心系统的预期,并跟踪这些预期如何随着该系统的使用而改变。 产品类别其他方面的进展是否移动了固定系统所适用的标准,很少用实地数据进行测试。

blocks.en: Adaptation-level theory supplies the mechanism for such a category effect. A judgment of any stimulus is made relative to an adaptation level, a reference that pools the stimuli a person has experienced ( Helson, 1964 ) . As experienced stimuli improve, the reference rises and the same stimulus is judged worse. Brickman and Campbell (1971) called the aggregate consequence a hedonic treadmill: improvements raise the reference point, so evaluations return toward where they were ( Frederick and Loewenstein, 1999 ; Diener et al., 2006 ) . A well-known aggregate pattern consistent with this account is that rising national income has not brought lasting increases in reported happiness ( Easterlin, 1974 ) . Range-frequency theory makes a related prediction for category ratings: the label a stimulus receives depends on where it sits among the stimuli a judge has encountered ( Parducci, 1965 ) . The reference, in these accounts, is formed by everything a person has experienced in the category, not only by the focal object.
blocks.zh: 适应级理论为这类效应提供了机制。 对任何刺激的判断是相对于适应水平的,这一参考汇集了一个人经历的刺激(Helson,1964年)。 随着经验刺激的改善,参照率上升,同样的刺激被判定更差. Brickman和Campbell(1971年)称综合后果是异想天开的跑步机:改进提高了参考点,因此评价回到原地(Frederick和Loewenstein,1999年;Diener等,2006年)。 与这一账户一致的一个众所周知的总格局是,国民收入的不断增长并没有给报告的幸福带来持久的增长(Easterlin,1974年)。 范围频率理论对分类评级做出了相关的预测:一个刺激获得的标签取决于它位于法官遇到的刺激中的位置(Parducci, 1965年). 在这些账户中,参考物是由一个人在类别中经历的一切所形成的,而不仅仅是由焦对象形成的.

blocks.en: Generative AI is a strong test of this category-level account. Between 2023 and 2024 new models arrived every few months, each better than the last, and many people used several assistants. If the reference is set by the category, a model that never changed would be judged more harshly as the models around it improved.
blocks.zh: Generative AI是对这个类别级账户的有力测试. 2023至2024年间,新型号每几个月到来一次,每个型号都比上个型号好,许多人使用过多位助手. 如果参照物是由类别设定的,那么随着周围的模型的改进,一个从未改变过的模型将会被更严厉的判断.

blocks.en: 2.3 A simple model of a verdict
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 一个简单的判决模式

blocks.en: To make the predictions precise, we separate three things: the vote that is observed, the quality of each answer as the voter perceives it, and the voter’s acceptance threshold. Consider a voter who receives two answers with perceived quality q a q_{a} and q b q_{b} and who holds a threshold r r , the quality an answer must reach before the voter accepts it. The voter rejects both answers when neither reaches the threshold, and otherwise prefers the better one: BothBad = 𝟏 { max ( q a , q b ) < r } , A wins = 𝟏 { q a > q b } when the vote is decisive . \textit{BothBad}=\mathbf{1}\{\max(q_{a},q_{b})<r\},\qquad\textit{A wins}=\mathbf{1}\{q_{a}>q_{b}\}\text{ when the vote is decisive}. (1) Perceived quality depends on the answer, on the task, and on how closely the voter scrutinizes the answer. Holding the two models fixed, the share of “both are bad” votes can therefore rise for three reasons. The threshold r r can rise. The voter can scrutinize more closely and notice more flaws in the same answer, which lowers q q . Or the answers can become worse for reasons outside the voter: prompts that are harder for these models, changes in how the models are served, or changes in the interface. The first two are changes in the judge, and either one makes the voter harder to satisfy; we call a voter who becomes harder to satisfy in either way pickier , and refer to the judge-side change as a rising standard of evaluation. The tests in Section 4 ask whether the third set of reasons explains the rise.
blocks.zh: 为了准确预测,我们将三件事分开:观察的投票、选民认为每个答案的质量以及选民的接受门槛。 如果选民收到两个质量问题, 投票人拒绝两个答案时都未达到门槛,否则更倾向于更好的答案: BothBad = 1 {最大 (q a, q b) < r }, A胜 = 1 { q a > q b } 当投票具有决定性时. \ textit{Both Bad}=\mathbf{ 1}\{\max (q_{a}, q_{b}}<r\},\qquad\ textit{A 胜利的Mathbf{ 1}QQQQQA}QQQBQQText{ 当投票是决定性的]。 (1)感知的质量取决于答案,任务,以及选民对答案的仔细审查. 两种模式都固定下来,“两者都是坏的”选票份额因此可以增加,原因有三。 阈值r可以上升. 投票人可以更仔细地检查,注意到同一答案中更多的缺陷,这降低了qq. 或者答案会因为选民之外的原因变得更糟糕:对这些模型更难的提示,模型服务方式的变化,或者界面的变化. 前两种是法官的更迭, 任何一种都让选民更难满足; 我们称选民更难满足, 第4节中的测试询问第三组原因是否解释了上升的原因.

blocks.en: The share of “both are bad” verdicts on the same unchanged pair of AI models rises over time.
blocks.zh: 对同一对不变的AI模型“两者都是坏”判决的比例随时间推移而上升。

blocks.en: A comparative verdict depends on the difference between two answers seen together, while an absolute verdict depends on a reference held in mind ( Thurstone, 1927 ) . People make absolute judgments by comparison with the stimuli they have recently encountered ( Stewart et al., 2005 ) , which is why absolute ratings are sensitive to context while paired comparisons are less so. Rating systems show the consequence. On an online labor market, average feedback scores rose sharply over time without a matching rise in quality, so the same score came to carry less information ( Filippas et al., 2022 ) , and re-anchoring what each level of a rating scale means can counter such drift ( Garg and Johari, 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 比较判断取决于两个共同看到的答案之间的差异,而绝对判断则取决于所铭记的参考(Thurstone, 1927. 与最近遇到的刺激相比,人们做出绝对判断(Stewart等人,2005年),这就是绝对评级对上下文敏感而对等比较较少的原因. 评级系统显示了后果。 在一个在线劳动力市场上,平均反馈得分随时间推移而急剧上升,而质量却没有相应提升,因此,同样的得分传递的信息较少(Filippas等人,2022年),并重新确定每一等级的评级意味着什么(Garg和Johari,2021年))。

blocks.en: Equation ( 1 ) alone does not fix how often the stronger model wins the decisive votes. A higher threshold changes which comparisons end decisively, so the stronger model’s share of the remaining decisive votes stays the same only if the comparisons that drop out are ordered like those that remain. The prediction for relative verdicts comes instead from the theory of comparative judgment: choosing the better of two answers seen side by side needs no reference held in mind, so a reference that drifts should leave it largely unchanged. Two alternatives predict that the share falls. If voters became less attentive or less able to tell answers apart, the stronger model’s share would move toward one half. If the stronger model of a pair became worse while the other did not, its share would fall.
blocks.zh: 单是方程式( 1 )并不能确定更强大的模式赢得决定性票数的频率. 更高的门槛值变化可以决定性地结束比较,因此只有当退出的比较像剩下的一样命令进行时,更强大的模型在剩余的决定性票数中的份额才会保持不变。 相对判断的预测取而代之的是比较判断的理论:选择两个并存的答案中较好的答案不需要考虑任何参考,所以一个漂移的参考应该让它基本保持不变. 两种选择预测份额会下降。 如果选民对答案的细心或分辨能力减弱,则更强大的模式份额将转向一半。 如果一对更强的模型变得更糟,而另一对则不然,则其份额会下降.

blocks.en: Among decisive verdicts on the same unchanged pair, the share won by the stronger model remains stable over time.
blocks.zh: 在对同一对不变的对决中,较强模式赢得的份额随时间推移保持稳定.

blocks.en: 2.4 Who becomes pickier
blocks.zh: 2.4 国家 谁更挑剔

blocks.en: Declining ratings for a fixed product can arise from changes in who rates. Early adopters of a product tend to like it more than later buyers ( Li and Hitt, 2008 ) , later reviewers differ from earlier ones ( Godes and Silva, 2012 ) , and the decision to post depends on the ratings already posted ( Moe and Schweidel, 2012 ) . A changing pool of raters could likewise produce harsher verdicts on Arena if, for example, early users were enthusiasts and later users were sceptics. Adaptation predicts change within raters as well: the same person becomes harsher as better AI becomes familiar, and people who arrive later bring a higher standard with them, because better AI was already part of their experience before they arrived. The two accounts can operate together, but they make different predictions. A changing pool predicts no change within a rater, while adaptation predicts change both within raters and across arrival cohorts.
blocks.zh: 固定产品的评级下降可能源于谁评级的变化。 一个产品的早期采用者往往比后来的购买者更喜欢(Li and Hitt, 2008.),后来的审查者与早期的(Godes and Silva, 2012.)不同,发布的决定取决于已经发布的收视率(Moe and Schweidel, 2012.). 如果早期用户是爱好者,而后来的用户是怀疑者,则变化中的评分库同样会对Arena作出更严厉的判决. 适应也预言了测出器内部的变化:随着更好的AI逐渐熟悉,同一人变得更严厉了,而后来到达的人也带来了更高的标准,因为更好的AI在到达之前已经是他们的经验的一部分. 这两个账户可以一起运作,但它们作出不同的预测. 变化中的集合预测一个测速器内部没有变化,而适应则预测在测速器内部和到来组群之间都有变化.

blocks.en: (a) Verdicts on the same unchanged models become harsher within the same judge over time. (b) Judges who arrive later are harsher on the same models from their first recorded vote.
blocks.zh: (a) 在同一个法官内部,对同样不变的模型作出的判决随着时间的推移变得更加严厉。 (b) 稍后到任的法官在第一次有记录的投票中对同样的模式更加严厉。

blocks.en: Finally, adaptation can be fast or slow. A momentary contrast effect would make a person harsher right after seeing a strong model. Adaptation-level theory describes a reference that pools experience over time ( Helson, 1964 ) , under which one more encounter shifts the reference only slightly. We therefore expect no sizeable harsher verdict right after an encounter with a strong model.
blocks.zh: 最后,适应可以是快的或慢的。 瞬间对比效应会让一个人在看到一个强健的模型后更加严厉. 适应级理论描述了一种汇集时间经验的参考(Helson,1964年),在这种参考下,再遇到一次只是略微转移了参考. 因此,在遇到一个强有力的模式之后,我们预计不会作出更严厉的判决。

blocks.en: A judge’s verdict on an unchanged pair does not become harsher right after an encounter with a stronger model.
blocks.zh: 法官对一对不变的判决在遇到更强大的模型后不会变得更严厉。

blocks.en: 3 Setting and Data
blocks.zh: 3 设置和数据

blocks.en: 3.1 Chatbot Arena
blocks.zh: 3.1 夏博特竞技场

blocks.en: Chatbot Arena is a public website, run by the research organization LMSYS during our period, where anyone can compare LLMs for free ( Zheng et al., 2023 ; Chiang et al., 2024 ) . In its main mode, a visitor writes a prompt and receives answers from two models drawn by the platform, shown side by side as “Model A” and “Model B”. The visitor may continue the conversation and then votes with one of four buttons: A is better, B is better, tie, or both are bad. The names of the two models are revealed only after the vote. The platform, not the visitor, chooses which two models appear, and it changes its sampling weights as models are added and retired. The votes feed a public leaderboard that is widely cited as a measure of LLM quality.
blocks.zh: Chatbot Arena是一个公共网站,由研究组织LMSYS在我们这个时期运营,任何人都可以免费比较LLMS(郑等,2023;蒋等,2024. 在其主要模式中,一名访客会写出一个提示并收到平台所绘制的两个模型的答案,并肩显示为"模式A"和"模式B". 访客可以继续交谈,然后用四个按钮中的一个进行投票: A更好,B更好,领带,或者两者都是坏的. 两个型号的名字只有在投票后才被披露. 站台不是访客,而是选择哪两个模型出现,随着模型的加入和退役,它改变其采样权重. 选票为公共领导板提供素材,被广泛称为LLM质量的衡量标准.

blocks.en: Three features make Arena suited to our question. Verdicts are blind, so a person cannot judge a model by its reputation. The same models are judged repeatedly over many months by a large and changing public. And many of the models are fixed versions, so the object being judged does not change.
blocks.zh: 三个特点使得阿雷纳适合我们的问题。 判决是盲目的,所以一个人不能根据其名声来判断一个模型. 数月来,一个庞大而变化的公众反复评判同样的模式。 而许多模型都是固定的版本,因此被判断的对象不会改变.

blocks.en: 3.2 Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据

blocks.en: We use the public battle log that LMSYS released to let others reproduce its leaderboard, in its release of 14 August 2024. 1 1 1 Available at https://storage.googleapis.com/arena_external_data/public/clean_battle_20240814_public.json ; the file we use has SHA-256 checksum 747c1c93…bd1b . It records 1,799,991 battles from 24 April 2023 to 14 August 2024. Each record gives the two models, the vote, a hashed identifier for the voter, a timestamp, the language of the prompt, the number of turns, token counts for the prompt and both answers, flags for code, math and refusals, and seven prompt-difficulty tags (specificity, domain knowledge, complexity, problem solving, creativity, technical accuracy, real-world application). LMSYS assigned the seven tags after the fact, by having one LLM annotator label every prompt against the same written criteria ( Li et al., 2024 ) , so a tag means the same thing for a prompt written in 2023 as for one written in 2024. The log contains no prompt or answer text.
blocks.zh: 我们使用LMSYS发布的公开战斗日志,让其他人在2024年8月14日的发布中复制了它的领跑板. 1 1 1 见https://storage.googleapis.com/arena_external_data/public/clean_battle_20240814_public.json;我们使用的文件有SHA-256 checksum 747c1c93.bd1b。 它记录了从2023年4月24日至2024年8月14日的1,799,991场战斗. 每张唱片都给出了两种模式,投票,选民的散列标识符,时间戳,即时语言,转弯次数,即时回答和两个答案的符号计数,代码标记,数学和拒绝,以及七个即时困难标记(特异性,域知识,复杂性,解决问题,创造力,技术精确度,现实世界应用). LMSYS根据相同的书面标准(Li等,2024年),通过每个提示符都有一个LLM的注释符标签,在事实之后指定了这7个标记,所以一个标记对于2023年的提示符意味着与2024年的提示符相同. 日志中没有即时或回答文本 。

blocks.en: The voter identifier is derived from the network address from which the vote was cast. LMSYS identifies users by IP address in its analysis of the platform ( Chiang et al., 2024 , Section 5.1) , and the code that prepares the battle log builds the voter field from it ( LMSYS, 2024 ) . We call it a judge identifier and use it to follow the same voter over time.
blocks.zh: 选民身份标识来源于投票时的网络地址. LMSYS在分析平台时通过IP地址识别用户(Chiang等,2024年,第5.1节),编写战斗日志的代码从中构建了选民场(LMSYS,2024年). 我们称它为法官身份识别器,并使用它来跟踪同一选民。

blocks.en: The “both are bad” button was added to the Arena interface on 29 April 2023. We therefore start on 1 May 2023, which leaves 1,795,852 blind battles. The analysis sample is the 1,260,967 of these that pair two frozen models (Section 3.3 ). Table 1 summarizes both.
blocks.zh: 2023年4月29日,Arena接口增加了“两者都是坏的”按钮。 因此,我们从2023年5月1日开始,这导致1,795,852起盲战. 分析样品是其中1,260,967个对两个被冻结的模型(第3.3节)。 表1汇总了两者。

blocks.zh: 表1:样本

blocks.en: 3.3 Frozen models
blocks.zh: 3.3 冻结型号

blocks.en: The design uses models whose versions are fixed. We assign each of the 129 models in the window to one of three classes by an explicit list (Appendix Table B ). The first class, dated API snapshots (33 models), contains names that vendors publish as fixed versions, such as gpt-4-0314 , gpt-4-0613 , claude-2.1 and claude-3-opus-20240229 . Its strictest tier is the 18 dated snapshots from OpenAI and Anthropic, which both vendors offered as pinned versions alongside undated aliases that moved to newer models; the other dated names include preview and experimental releases. The second class, fixed open weights (73 models), contains models whose weights were published as a single checkpoint, such as llama-2-70b-chat and mixtral-8x7b-instruct-v0.1 . We call the models in these two classes frozen . The third class, aliases (23 models), contains names that can point to a changing model: undated vendor aliases ( claude-1 , gemini-pro ), consumer products ( bard-jan-24-gemini-pro ), models that search the web, and the Vicuna names, which LMSYS upgraded across versions. We exclude the aliases.
blocks.zh: 该设计采用版本固定的模型. 我们通过一个明确的列表(附录表B),将窗口中的129个模型中的每个模型分配给三个类别中的一个。 头等舱,日期为API快照(33个型号),收录了销售商以固定版本发布的名称,如gpt-4-0314,gpt-4-0613,claude-2.1和claude-3-opus-20240229等. 其最严格的层级是OpenAI和Anthropic的18个日期快照,这两个销售商都以被标注的版本提供,并配以未标注日期的别名,这些别名被移动到较新的模型;其他日期的名字包括预览和实验发布. 二级为固定开口重量(73个型号),包含其重量被公布为一个单一检查站的模型,如:lama-2-70b-chat和mixtral-8x7b-instruct-v0.1. 我们称这两个班的模特儿都冻僵了 第三类别名(23个型号)包含可以指向变化型号的名称:未注明日期的供应商别名(Claude-1,Gemini-pro),消费品(bard-jan-24-gemini-pro),搜索网络的模型,以及LMSYS跨版本升级的维库纳名. 我们排除了别名。

blocks.en: A frozen pair is a pair of two frozen models. Frozen pairs account for 1,260,967 battles (70 % of the window), 2,231 distinct pairs and 106 models; 430,370 battles are between two dated API snapshots.
blocks.zh: 被冷冻的一对是两个被冷冻的模型的一对. 被冰冻的一对占了1,260,967个战役(占窗口的70%),2,231个截然不同的一对和106个型号;430,370个战役介于两个有日期的API快照之间.

blocks.en: A fixed version can still be served with a different system prompt, decoding setting or limit on answer length. Such changes would usually show up in what the model writes, and the log records the length of every answer. For each frozen model active for at least three months, we estimate the trend in the length of its own answers, holding the opponent, the prompt length and the language fixed (Appendix Table C ). The main snapshots, among them gpt-4-0314 , gpt-4-0613 , gpt-4-1106-preview and claude-2.1 , show small estimated trends; we call the eight models whose estimated linear trend passes a strict screening rule length-stable . Answer length registers serving changes that alter how much a model writes, such as a new system prompt or output limit. We use the dated OpenAI and Anthropic snapshots, the open-weight models and the length-stable models as three separate tests of the serving explanation.
blocks.zh: 固定版本仍然可以通过不同的系统即时,解码设置或对答题长度的限制来服务. 这种变化通常会在模型所写的内容中出现,日志记录每个答案的长度. 对于每个至少活动了三个月的被冻结模型,我们估计了自身答案长度的趋势,持有对手,即时长度和语言固定(附录表C. 主要的快照,包括gpt-4-0314,gpt-4-0613,gpt-4-1106-preview和claude-2.1,显示了估计的小趋势;我们称之为八种模型,其估计的线性趋势通过严格的筛选规则长度稳定. 解答长度记录为改变模型写作量的变化服务,例如新系统即时或输出限制。 我们使用日期为OpenAI和Anthropic的快照,开口量模型和长度平稳模型,作为服务解释的三个独立的测试.

blocks.en: 3.4 Outcomes
blocks.zh: 3.4 结果

blocks.en: The main outcome is an indicator that a vote is “both are bad”. In terms of Equation ( 1 ), it records that neither answer, as the voter perceived it, reached the voter’s threshold. We also study the share of votes for one of the two answers (decisive votes), the share of ties, and, among decisive votes, whether the stronger of the two models won. The stronger model is defined by a Bradley–Terry rating, which infers each model’s strength from its wins and losses against all opponents, estimated once on the whole window ( Bradley and Terry, 1952 ; Hunter, 2004 ) ; a single rating summarizes a frozen model because its version does not change. Across all battles in the window, 17.0 % of votes are “both are bad” and 18.7 % are ties.
blocks.zh: 主要结果是有迹象表明,投票“都是不好的”。 在方程式(1)方面,据记录,选民认为,两个答复都没有达到选民的门槛。 我们还研究两个答案之一的选票份额(决定性票数),关系份额,以及在决定性票数中,两个模式中更强者是否获胜. 更强大的模型由布拉德利-特瑞评级(Bradley–Terry)定义,该评级推断出每个模型的实力来自于其对所有对手的胜负,在整个窗口上估计过一次(Bradley和Terry,1952;Hunter,2004);单一评级总结了被冻结的模型,因为其版本没有改变. 在窗口中的所有战斗中,17.0%的选票是“坏的”,18.7%是关系。

blocks.en: Because the vote records the outcome of a comparison, Section 4 tests whether measured changes in prompts, models and interface account for the rise in “both are bad” votes; the part they do not account for we attribute to the judges.
blocks.zh: 由于表决记录了比较的结果,第4节检验了“两者都是坏的”选票增加的原因,是否衡量了提示、模型和界面的变化;它们并不说明我们归属于法官。

blocks.en: 4 Empirical Approach
blocks.zh: 4 经验方法

blocks.en: 4.1 Within-pair comparison
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 内部比较

blocks.en: Standard errors are clustered two ways, by model pair and by calendar week ( Cameron et al., 2011 ) . Clustering by pair allows any correlation among votes on the same models; clustering by week allows shocks that hit all votes in a given week, such as a news event or a temporary change to the site. Clustering by pair alone gives a standard error less than half as large (0.07 instead of 0.18 for the main estimate), so common weekly shocks matter, and we cluster by pair and week in all specifications that pool votes across judges. The window has 68 calendar weeks, 33 of them in 2024.
blocks.zh: 标准错误按模型对和日历周分为两组(Cameron等,2011年)。 组合成对允许在同一模型上的选票之间有任何关联;按周分组允许在特定一周内冲击所有选票的冲击,如新闻事件或网站的临时更改. 单是成对地组合,就会产生一个不到一半的标准误差(主要估计值为0.07而不是0.18),所以常见的每周震荡物质,我们按每对和每星期将所有规格分组,把评委的选票汇集在一起。 窗口有68个日历周,其中33个在2024年.

blocks.en: 4.2 What else could lower perceived quality
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 还有什么能降低质量的

blocks.en: Equation ( 1 ) implies that, with the pair held fixed, more “both are bad” votes require a higher threshold, closer scrutiny, or answers that became worse for reasons outside the judge. We test three such reasons.
blocks.zh: 等式(1)意味着,在固定了对等后,更多的“两者都是坏的”选票需要更高的门槛、更仔细的审查或因法官以外的原因而变得更加糟糕的答复。 我们检验了三个这样的原因。

blocks.en: The prompts. People may ask harder questions over time, or questions that suit these models less well. We add controls in three blocks, ordered by how far they are from the original request. The first block describes the prompt’s content: fixed effects for the 20 most common prompt languages, code and math flags, and the seven difficulty tags. The second adds the conversation (multi-turn, prompt length), which can depend on earlier answers, and the third adds the answers (refusal, answer length), which are outcomes of the models. We estimate the model on single-turn conversations, where the prompt is the whole request, and on easy, single-turn English prompts (no complexity, problem-solving, code or math tag). We also estimate it on the subset of prompts that the log flags as recurring at high frequency. Finally, we use the coefficient-stability approach of Oster (2019) to ask how much selection on unobserved prompt features, relative to the observed ones, would be needed to explain the trend away, letting the share of the variation in votes that a full set of controls could explain vary.
blocks.zh: 诱发. 人们可能会随着时间推移而提出更困难的问题,或者提出不太适合这些模型的问题. 我们增加三个街区的控制,按它们距离最初请求有多远来排序. 第一个区块描述了该快报的内容:20种最常用快报语言的固定效果,代码和数学旗帜,以及7个难度标记. 二加对话(多回转,即时长度),这可以依靠更早的答案,而三加答案(反驳,即答长度),是模型的结果. 我们估计单回合对话的模型,在单回合对话中,提示是整个请求,在简单,单回合英语的提示上(不复杂,解决问题,代码或数学标记). 我们还估计,这些标记在高频率下重复出现。 最后,我们使用奥斯特的系数稳定方法(2019年)询问,相对于观测到的迅速特征,需要对未观测到的即时特征作出多少选择,以解释趋势的去向,使整套控制能够解释的选票变动比例有所不同。

blocks.en: The serving. A fixed version could be served with a different configuration. We re-estimate the model on pairs of dated OpenAI and Anthropic snapshots, on pairs of open-weight models, and on pairs of length-stable models.
blocks.zh: 服务。 固定版本可以使用不同的配置. 我们重新估计了 日期为OpenAI和Anthropic的一对快照 和一对开口重量的模型 以及一对长度稳定模型的模型

blocks.en: The interface. Arena’s interface was changed several times. We use the public history of the source file of the anonymous battle page in the software that runs Arena ( LMSYS, 2024 ) : 56 commits changed it during the window, eleven of them by at least 50 lines. We re-estimate the model with fixed effects for each period between major changes, and separately for each period between any two changes, so that a jump at a change is absorbed and only the trend within periods identifies β \beta . We also drop the days around each change, estimate the jump at each major change directly with a local regression that includes pair fixed effects, and compare those jumps with jumps estimated in the same way at placebo dates. These tests use commit dates, the recorded timing of each code change.
blocks.zh: 界面. Arena的界面曾被多次更改. 我们使用运行Arena(LMSYS, 2024)的软件中匿名战斗页的源文件公开历史: 56 承诺在窗口期间更改, 其中11行至少50行. 我们重新估计在主要变化之间的每个期间具有固定效应的模型,并在任何两个变化之间的每个期间分别进行,这样就可以吸收变化时的跳跃,只有期间的趋势才能确定β\β. 我们还将每个变化周围的天数减少,直接用一个包括对定效果的局部回归来估计每个重大变化的跳跃,并将这些跳跃与安慰剂日期估计的跳跃进行同样的比较. 这些测试使用承诺日期,每次代码更改的记录时间.

blocks.en: 4.3 Judges
blocks.zh: 4.3 法官

blocks.en: The pool of voters changes over time. For Hypothesis 3 (a), we add identifier fixed effects among judge identifiers observed over at least one month, so that each voter is compared with themselves. Because additive judge and pair effects assume that a voter’s taste for a pair is stable, we also estimate the model with a fixed effect for each identifier-by-pair combination, using the combinations judged more than a month apart, which compares the same identifier on the same pair at different times. Within an identifier, calendar time and experience on the platform rise together; we separate them by controlling for the number of earlier recorded votes. For Hypothesis 3 (b), we keep only each identifier’s first recorded vote, for identifiers whose first vote falls inside the window, and estimate Equation ( 2 ) with arrival date as the time variable. These are arrival cohorts: they compare people who first voted at different dates, on the same pair, at their first recorded vote.
blocks.zh: 选民队伍随时间而变化。 关于假设3(a),我们在法官识别器中添加至少一个月的识别特征固定效应,以便每个选民都与自己进行比较。 由于添加剂判断和配对效果假设选民对一对的口味是稳定的,因此我们也用相隔一个多月的判断组合来估计每个标识-pair组合的有固定效果的模型,这些组合在不同时间比较了同一个配对上相同的标识. 在一个标识内,日历时间和平台上的经验一起上升;我们通过控制先前记录的票数来将它们分开。 对于假设3(b),我们只保留每个标识符的第一次记录投票,对于第一次投票在窗口内的标识符,并估计以到达日期为时间变量的方程式(2个)。 这些是到达组群:他们比较了在不同的日期,在同一对时间,在第一次有记录的投票中第一次投票的人。

blocks.en: 4.4 Momentary contrast
blocks.zh: 4.4 时间对比

blocks.en: Hypothesis 4 concerns momentary contrast. The platform draws the pair of models for each battle, so the strength of the models a voter saw in their previous recorded battle was not chosen by the voter. We regress the verdict on a frozen pair on the rating of the better model in the voter’s previous recorded battle, with pair, week and arrival-week fixed effects and fixed effects for the number of earlier battles, and separately with identifier fixed effects.

blocks.en: 4.5 Re-anchoring with frozen references
blocks.zh: 4.5 用被冻结的参考文献重新查找

blocks.en: If the drift is a shift shared by all frozen pairs, it can be measured on some pairs and removed from others. We test this out of sample. For each frozen model with at least 10,000 votes over at least four months, we estimate calendar-month effects on “both are bad” from all frozen pairs that do not involve that model, subtract them from the verdicts on the model’s own pairs, and estimate the remaining trend with pair fixed effects. A model whose own pairs drifted in ways the other pairs did not would keep a trend after this adjustment.
blocks.zh: 如果漂移是被所有被冻结的对子所共有的转变,则可以在一些对子上测量并去除其他对子. 我们从样本中测试出来 对于每个在至少四个月中至少拥有一万票的被冻结模型,我们估计所有不涉及该模型的被冻结的对子的日历月影响“两者都是不好的 ” , 从对模型本身的对子的判断中减去这些结果,并估计有对子固定效果的剩余趋势。 其自己的一对以其他一对的方式漂移的模型在调整后不会保持趋势.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Better models, steady verdicts
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 更好的模型,稳定的判断

blocks.en: Figure 1 sets the scene. Panel (a) shows how much better the models on Arena became. The average rating of the models in each month’s battles rose from 823 in May 2023 to 1067 in August 2024, a gain of 245 points on the Elo scale, the rating scale used in chess, on which a 400-point gap means ten-to-one odds. A model drawn from the August 2024 battles would be expected to score about 78 % against a model drawn from the May 2023 battles, and 80 % of the model appearances in August 2024 came from models rated above every model on Arena in May 2023.
blocks.zh: 图一设置了场景. (a) 小组说明阿雷纳岛上的模型有了多大的改进。 每个月的战役中模型的平均评分从2023年5月的823分上升到2024年8月的1067分,在埃罗分级上收获了245分,是国际象棋中使用的分级分级分级分级分,在分级分级分级上,400分的差距意味着10比1的胜负. 从2024年8月战役中抽取出的一个型号,预计相对于从2023年5月战役中抽取出的一个型号,得分约78%;而2024年8月出场的型号有80%来自2023年5月在阿雷纳上被评为每个型号上上方的型号.

blocks.en: Panel (b) shows the verdicts. Across all battles, the share of votes saying “both are bad” moved between 13.8 % and 20.6 % from month to month, and it ended the period (20.6 %) close to where it began (19.4 %). Far better models did not reduce the share of answers that people rejected outright. The orange line shows that, within the same pair of frozen models, the share of “both are bad” votes rose steadily. The pattern resembles a treadmill: the models improved, and the verdict on a fixed pair of models became harsher. The rest of this section asks whether the harsher verdicts come from the judges.
blocks.zh: (b) 小组显示判决。 在所有战斗中,说“两者都是坏的”的选票比例从每月13.8%到20.6%之间移动,结束的时期(20.6%)接近开始的时间(19.4%)。 更好的模式并没有降低人们直接拒绝的答案的比例。 橙线显示,在同一对被冻结的模型中,“两者都是坏的”选票份额稳步上升。 模式类似跑步机:模型改进了,对一对固定模型的判断变得更加严厉. 本节其余部分询问更严厉的判决是否来自法官.

(a) Average Bradley–Terry rating (Elo scale) of the models in each month’s battles, and the rating of the best model with at least 500 battles that month. (b) Change since May 2023 in the share of “both are bad” votes: raw, across all battles (blue), and within the same frozen model pair (orange; calendar-month effects from a regression with pair fixed effects; shaded band is the 95% confidence interval, standard errors clustered by pair and week).

blocks.en: 5.2 Same models, harsher verdicts
blocks.zh: 5.2 国家 同样的模型,更严厉的判决

blocks.en: Table 2 , panel A, first column, estimates Equation ( 2 ). Within the same pair of frozen models, the share of “both are bad” votes rises by 1.71 percentage points a month (SE 0.18), on a mean of 17.1 %. The monthly effects in Figure 1 (b) show a climb rather than a single jump: the share for the same pairs is 6.5 points above its May 2023 level by December 2023 and 17.8 points (SE 2.7) above it by August 2024.
blocks.zh: 表2,小组A,第一栏,估计方程式(2个)。 在同一对被冻结的模型中,“两者均为坏票”的份额每月增加1.71个百分点(SE 0.18),平均为17.1%。 图1 (b)中的月度效应显示为攀登而非单跳:同对的分数到2023年12月将比其2023年5月的水平高6.5分,到2024年8月将比其高出17.8分(SE 2.7).

blocks.en: Most of the votes come late in the period. Voters cast 92 % of the votes on frozen pairs in 2024, when Arena’s traffic was highest, and the vote-weighted median pair was judged over 2.1 months. The common trend is therefore traced by many overlapping pairs, each observed for part of the period. Panel B of Table 2 uses only January to August 2024, when the data are densest: the share of “both are bad” votes rises by 1.91 points a month (SE 0.23). The trend is similar when every pair-month cell gets equal weight ( + + 1.45) and among pairs judged over at least three months ( + + 1.54), and smaller but clearly positive among the few pairs judged over at least six months ( + + 1.10), which are mostly 2023-era open models (Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 在此期间,大多数选票来得较晚。 选民在2024年将92%的选票投给被冻结的一对,当时阿雷纳的交通量最高,而得票加权中位数对在2.1个多月的时间里判断出. 因此,许多相互重叠的对子可以追溯到共同的趋势,每个对子都观察到这一时期的一部分。 表2的B组只使用2024年1至8月的数据最密集:“两者都是坏的”选票份额每月增加1.91分(SE 0.23)。 当每对一对一月细胞获得等重(++1.45),并在至少三个月(++1.54)时间内被判断的对一对细胞中出现类似趋势,在至少六个月(++1.10)时间内被判断的对一对细胞中,体积较小但明显为正数,这些细胞大多为2023-时代的开放型号(表3).

blocks.en: Figure 2 shows the pattern without a regression. It plots the fourteen frozen pairs that were judged at least fifty times both in May–October 2023 and in February–August 2024. The share of “both are bad” votes rose in all fourteen. Weighting each pair by its smaller period count, the share went from 15.5 % to 23.3 %, a rise of 7.8 points (resampling interval 6.4 to 9.1). The late votes on these pairs came on average 5.3 months after the early ones, so the rise is about 1.48 points a month. The fourteen pairs confirm the direction of the trend without relying on a regression. The rise appears for gpt-4-0613 against claude-2.0 and against gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 , pairs that were among the strongest available in 2023, as well as for pairs of small open models.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了没有回归的规律. 在2023年5月至10月以及2024年2月至8月,它至少对14对被判定为50次的冰冻夫妇进行了规划。 在所有十四个国家中,“两者都是坏的”票数都增加了。 按较小的时期计算每对体重,份额从15.5%增至23.3%,上升了7.8分(抽样间隔6.4至9.1)。 这些一对的后期选票平均在早期的后5.3个月才出现,因此涨幅约为每月1.48分. 这14对夫妇在不依赖回归的情况下确认了趋势的方向. 上升出现在gpt-4-0613对克劳德-2.0和gpt-3.5-turbo-0613对中,是2023年现存最强的一对,以及一对小开口型.

blocks.en: Table 2: Verdicts on frozen model pairs over time: absolute and relative
blocks.zh: 表2:关于冻结型号对随时间推移的判断:绝对数和相对数

blocks.en: Figure 2: Every pair judged often in both periods became “both are bad” more often. Frozen model pairs with at least 50 votes in May–October 2023 and in February–August 2024; vote counts in parentheses (early/late). Bars are 95% binomial confidence intervals.
blocks.zh: 图2:在两个阶段中经常被评为“坏”的每一对。 在2023年5-10月和2024年2-8月,至少拥有50票的被冻模型对;以括号(早/晚)计票. 酒吧是95%的二元置信间隔.

blocks.en: 5.3 The bar moves, not the ranking
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 酒吧动了,不是排名

blocks.en: Table 2 , columns 2–4, and Figure 3 show where the extra “both are bad” votes come from. The share of decisive votes falls by 1.62 points a month (SE 0.14), and ties do not change ( − - 0.09 points a month, SE 0.22). In aggregate, the share of “both are bad” votes grows at the expense of decisive votes, not of ties.
blocks.zh: 表2第2至4栏和图3显示额外 " 两者都是坏的 " 选票来自何处。 决定性票数的比例每月下降1.62分(SE 0.14),而纽带不变(---0.09分/月,SE 0.22). 总的来说,“两者都是坏的”选票份额的增加是以决定性的选票而不是关系为代价的。

blocks.en: Among decisive votes on pairs whose ratings differ, the stronger model wins 66.7 % of the time, and its linear trend over the whole period is + + 0.13 points a month (SE 0.13). Figure 3 (b) shows that the stronger model’s share fell during the first months of the sample, when few votes were cast on a small set of early models, reaching 9.4 points below its May 2023 level. From December 2023 onward it stays between 4.1 and 6.0 points below that level, while the share of “both are bad” votes climbs by about 11 points over the same months. In 2024 (Table 2 , panel B), the trend in the stronger model’s share is 0.00 points a month (SE 0.13). Over the 7.4 months of 2024 in the data, the 95% interval for the change in the stronger model’s share runs from − - 1.9 to 1.9 points, while the share of “both are bad” votes rose by about 14 points.
blocks.zh: 在对收视率有差异的一对进行决定性投票中,较强的模型获得66.7%的时间,其整个期间的线性趋势为++0.13分(SE 0.13). 图3(b)显示,较强模型的份额在样本的头几个月有所下降,当时对一套小型早期模型投了很少票,比2023年5月的水平低了9.4分。 从2023年12月起,它保持在低于该水平的4.1至6.0分之间,而“两者都是坏的”选票份额在同一个月中上升了约11分。 在2024年(表2,B面板),更强大的模型份额的趋势是每月0.00分(SE.0.13). 在2024年的7.4个月中,强模型份额变化的95%的间隔时间从−-1.9分到1.9分,而“两者都是坏的”选票份额则上升了约14分。

blocks.en: This result does not depend on how “stronger” is defined. Ratings that drop all ties correlate at .999 with the main ratings and give a trend of + + 0.09 points a month. Cross-fitted ratings, estimated on alternate calendar weeks and applied to votes in the other weeks, give + + 0.13 over the whole period and + + 0.01 in 2024. In 2024, voters who picked one answer picked the stronger model’s answer about as often at the end of the period as at the start, while rejecting both answers far more often, as Hypotheses 1 and 2 predict.
blocks.zh: 这一结果并不取决于如何界定 " 更强 " 。 降下所有关节的分数与主要分数相挂钩,并给出了每月++0.09分的趋势. 相适应的收视率,在相交日历周估计并应用于其他周的投票,在整个期间给予++0.13分,2024年给予++0.01分. 2024年,选择一个答案的选民们选择了更强模型的答案,在末期和开始时一样频繁,同时更频繁地拒绝了两个答案,如"假说1"和"2"所预测的那样.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Absolute verdicts drift; the relative verdict is flat from late 2023. Calendar-month effects (relative to May 2023) from regressions with model-pair fixed effects. (a) Shares of all votes on frozen pairs. (b) Share of decisive votes won by the higher-rated model, pairs whose ratings differ by at least 20 Elo points. Shaded bands are 95% confidence intervals, standard errors clustered by pair and week. The grey area marks 2024.
blocks.zh: 图3:绝对判决浮动;相对判决自2023年末起为平分. 历月效应(与2023年5月相比)来自有模型-pair固定效应的回归. (a) 在被冻结的一对中分享所有选票。 (b) 高评级模式赢得的决定性票数份额,对等的评级至少为20埃洛分。 阴影波段为95%的置信间隔,标准出错按对和周分组. 灰色区域标记为2024.

blocks.en: 5.4 Not the prompts, the models or the interface
blocks.zh: 5.4 (中文(简体) ). 不是提示、模型或接口

blocks.en: Table 3 and Figure 4 test the explanations outside the judge. Across the 28 specifications in Table 3 , the trend ranges from + + 0.97 to + + 2.61 points a month; it is positive in every one and statistically significant in all but one.
blocks.zh: 表3和图4检验法官以外的解释。 在表3的28个规格中,趋势从每月+ + 0.97到+ + 2.61分不等;每个规格呈正数,除一个以外,所有规格都具有统计意义。

blocks.en: Prompts. Controlling for prompt content (language fixed effects, code, math and all seven difficulty tags) gives + + 1.63 points a month; adding the conversation gives + + 1.57, and adding the answers gives + + 1.59. In single-turn conversations with prompt-content controls the trend is + + 1.60, and on easy, single-turn English prompts, where the task is simplest and changes least, it is + + 1.30 (SE 0.17). It is + + 1.53 for English prompts and between + + 1.52 and + + 3.75 in each of the seven most common prompt languages (Appendix Table 7 ). On the subset of prompts flagged as recurring at high frequency, the point estimate is + + 1.61 with a wide interval (SE 0.96), because these votes are few. The controls raise the within-pair R 2 R^{2} from 0.001 to 0.020 while moving the coefficient only from + + 1.71 to + + 1.57. Under the proportional-selection assumption of Oster (2019) , and with her suggested maximum R 2 R^{2} of 1.3 times the controlled R 2 R^{2} , selection on unobserved prompt features would have to be 36 times as strong as selection on the observed ones to bring the trend to zero (Appendix Table 10 ). Appendix Table 10 varies that maximum. With selection on unobserved features as strong as on observed ones, the trend reaches zero only if that maximum R 2 R^{2} is 0.23, about twelve times what all observed prompt features explain; at a maximum of 0.10 the adjusted trend is + + 0.98.
blocks.zh: 提示 提示 控制即时内容(语言固定效果,代码,数学和所有七个难度标记)每月给出++1.63分;再加对话给出++1.57分,再加答案给出++1.59分. 在有即时内容控制的单回合对话中,趋势是++ 1.60,在简单而单回合的英语提示上,任务最简单而变化最小的为++ 1.30(SE 0.17)。 对英语提示来说是++1.53,在++1.52到+之间. 在最常用的7种即时语言中,每种语言为3.75(附录表7.). 在被标记为高频重发的提示子上,点数估计是++1.61,间隔很广(SE 0.96),因为这些选票很少. 控制将内部R 2 R^{2}从0.001升至0.020,而系数仅从+ 1.71升至+ 1.57。 根据奥斯特的比例选择假设(2019年),加上她建议的最大R 2 R^{2}是受控R 2 R^{2}的1.3倍,对未观测到的即时特征的选择必须比对被观测到的特征的选择强出36倍,才能使趋势为零(附录表10). 附录表10的上限不同。 由于在未观测到的特征上的选择与所观测到的特征一样强烈,只有在最大R 2 R^{2}为0.23时,趋势才达到零,大约是所有观测到的即时特征的十二倍;调整后的趋势为++ 0.98。

blocks.en: Models and serving. For pairs of two dated OpenAI or Anthropic snapshots, the trend is + + 1.41 points a month (SE 0.20); for all dated snapshots it is + + 1.55, and for pairs of two open-weight models + + 2.12. For pairs of length-stable models it is + + 1.16 (SE 0.16), and + + 0.97 for length-stable snapshots. These subsets cover different models and periods, and the trend is positive and significant in each.
blocks.zh: 模特儿和服务 对于两对日期为OpenAI或Anthropic快照,趋势是++1.41分(SE 0.20);对于所有日期为++1.55的快照,以及两对开口重量型号++2.12的快照;对于长度稳定型号,趋势是++1.16(SE 0.16)和+0.97的快照。 这些子集涵盖不同的模型和时期,每个子集的趋势都是积极而显著的.

blocks.en: Interface. With fixed effects for each period between the eleven major changes to the battle page, the trend within periods is + + 2.61 points a month; with fixed effects for each of the periods between all 56 changes, most of them a few days long, it is + + 1.03 (SE 0.31). Dropping the three days around every change, 36 % of the votes, gives + + 1.77. Estimated directly with a local regression, the jumps at the major changes average 1.6 points in absolute value, about the same as at 36 placebo dates (1.6 points), and the two that are significant are negative (Appendix Table 8 ). On 7 August 2024, in the last week of the log, daily traffic rose from about 5,808 to 7,511 battles and the share of “both are bad” votes jumped; dropping that week gives + + 1.56. Within the periods between observed changes to the page, the trend stays positive, at + + 1.03 to + + 2.61 points a month depending on how finely the periods are drawn.
blocks.zh: 界面. 战斗页的11个重大变动之间的每个期间的固定影响,期间的趋势是:每月+2.61分;所有56个变动之间的每个期间的固定影响,大多数持续了几天,是++1.03(SE 031). 将每起变化的3天,36 % 的选票给出+ + 1.77. 。 以本地回归为直接估计值,在绝对值上主要变化的跳跃平均为1.6分,大约与36个安慰剂日期(1.6分)相同,两个显著是负数(附录表8)。 2024年8月7日,在日志的最后一周,日客流量从大约5,808起升至7,511起,“两者都是坏的”选票份额猛增;当周的下降给了++1.56分。 在所观察到的页面变化之间的时期内,趋势保持正数,每月的++ 1.03分到+ 2.61分,这取决于时间的长短。

blocks.en: Pair strength and prolific voters. The trend is similar for the weakest third of pairs ( + + 1.63), the middle third ( + + 1.76) and the strongest third ( + + 1.75). The most active 1% of judge identifiers cast 22 % of the votes on frozen pairs; dropping them gives + + 1.65.
blocks.zh: 平分实力和繁多的选民. 趋势相近的是:最弱的三分之一对(++1.63),中第三对(++1.76)和最强的三分之一对(++1.75). 最活跃的1%的法官识别器将22%的选票投给被冻结的一对;丢弃后给出++1.65.

blocks.en: Table 3: Robustness: change in “both are bad” per month within frozen model pairs
blocks.zh: 表3 强性:冷冻型号对内每月“坏”的变化

blocks.en: Figure 4: One estimate, many cuts. Change in the share of “both are bad” votes per month within frozen model pairs, with 95% confidence intervals. The dashed line marks the main estimate.
blocks.zh: 图4:一个估计数,许多削减。 每月在被冻结的模型对内,“两者”份额的改变为差选票,置信间隔为95%。 虚线为主估计值.

blocks.en: 5.5 People become pickier
blocks.zh: 5.5 人变得更挑剔

blocks.en: Table 4 turns to the judges. If the rise came only from a changing pool of voters, it would disappear when each voter is compared with themselves. It does not. The 24,508 judge identifiers observed over at least a month make up 6 % of identifiers but cast 29 % of the votes on frozen pairs. Among these identifiers, with identifier and pair fixed effects, the share of “both are bad” votes rises by 1.90 points a month (SE 0.13); among identifiers observed over at least three months it rises by 1.74. Comparing the same identifier on the same pair, using the 11,642 votes in the 3,437 identifier-pair combinations judged more than a month apart (1,292 identifiers, 459 pairs), gives + + 2.30 (SE 0.68), and + + 2.24 with prompt-content controls. Controlling for the number of earlier votes leaves + + 1.50 points a month, and dropping the most active 1% of identifiers leaves + + 1.83. The standard error is similar when clustering by identifier and week (0.15). Hypothesis 3 (a) holds: within the same identifier, and within the same identifier-pair combination, verdicts become harsher.
blocks.zh: 表4转至法官。 如果涨幅只来自不断变化的选民群,那么当每个选民都与自己进行比较时,就会消失. 它没有。 在至少一个月的时间里观察到的24 508个法官识别器占识别器的6%,但将29%的选票投给被冻结的对子。 在这些标识符中,有标识符和对等固定效果的,“两者均为坏票”的份额每月增加1.90分(SE 0.13);在至少三个月内观察到的标识符中,有的增加了1.74分。 比较同一对的同一标识符,使用3,437个标识符-pair组合中判断相隔超过一个月的11,642票(1,292个标识符,459对),给出了++ 2.30(SE 0.68)和++ 2.24的即时内容控制. 对先前票数的控制每月会离开++1.50分,将最活跃的1%的标识符离开++1.83. 标准错误在按标识符和周(0.15)进行分组时类似. 假设3(a)认为:在同一识别特征范围内,在同一识别特征-pair组合范围内,判决变得更加严厉。

blocks.en: Arrival cohorts tell the same story. Using only each identifier’s first recorded vote, voters who arrive later are harsher on the same frozen pairs: + + 1.25 points per month of arrival date (SE 0.13), + + 1.15 with prompt-content and conversation controls, + + 1.17 for English prompts and + + 1.17 without the final week. Figure 5 shows the climb: by August 2024 a first recorded verdict on the same pair is 11.6 points (SE 2.7) more likely to be “both are bad” than one in May 2023. A first recorded vote follows no earlier recorded vote on Arena, so the cohort pattern reflects what voters bring with them when they arrive, as Hypothesis 3 (b) predicts.
blocks.zh: 到达的人群 讲述同样的故事。 使用每个标识符的首张有记录的选票,后来到达的选民在同一个被冷冻的对联上更加严厉:++1.25分/月到达日期(SE 0.13),++1.15分带有即时内容和对话控制,++1.17分的英语提示和++1.17分没有最后一周. 图5显示了攀登情况:到2024年8月,同一对的首次记录判决为11.6分(SE 2.7分),比2023年5月的1分更可能“都不好”。 第一次记录表决是在先前没有就阿雷纳进行记录表决之后进行的,因此,如假设3(b)所预测的,分组投票模式反映了选民到达后带来的东西。

blocks.en: Recorded experience goes with harsher verdicts too. In the same calendar month, votes cast after at least ten earlier votes are 2.56 points more likely to be “both are bad” than earlier votes (SE 0.31). Both patterns point to the judges: the same identifier becomes harsher over time, and later cohorts start harsher than earlier ones.
blocks.zh: 有记录的经验也伴随着更严厉的判决。 在同一个日历月,在至少十次投票后投票的2.56分可能比先前的投票(SE 0.31)更“坏”。 两种模式都指向了法官:同样的识别特征随着时间推移变得更严厉,而后一批人开始比前几批人更严厉.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Newcomers arrive pickier. Calendar-month effects (relative to May 2023) on “both are bad” within frozen model pairs, for all votes and for each judge identifier’s first recorded vote by month of arrival. Shaded bands are 95% confidence intervals, standard errors clustered by pair and week.
blocks.zh: 图5 新来者来取取. 日历月影响(与2023年5月有关), 冻结的模型对内, 阴影波段为95%的置信间隔,标准出错按对和周分组.

blocks.en: Table 4: Who becomes pickier
blocks.zh: 表4:谁更挑剔

blocks.en: 5.6 No momentary contrast
blocks.zh: 5.6 国家 没有瞬间对比

blocks.en: The last rows of Table 4 ask whether verdicts jump after a single encounter. A momentary contrast would make a voter harsher right after meeting a strong model. The data show no such effect. The rating of the better model in a voter’s previous recorded battle is unrelated to their next verdict on a frozen pair ( − - 0.11 points per 100 rating points, SE 0.09). With identifier fixed effects the coefficient is − - 0.25 (SE 0.09), so a strong previous model goes with a slightly milder next verdict, not a harsher one. Hypothesis 4 holds. The absence of a short-run contrast fits a reference that pools experience over time.
blocks.zh: 表4的最后一行询问判决是否在一次相遇后跳出. 暂时的对比会让选民在遇到强势模式后更加严厉. 数据显示没有这种效果。 选民之前记录的战役对更好模式的评分与他们下一次对一对被冻结的一对判决(---每100分评分0.11分,SE 0.09分)无关. 具有识别特征的固定效应的系数为−-0.25 (SE 0.09),所以一个强健的上个模型会有一个略微温和的下个判断,而不是更严厉的判断. 假说四住. 缺乏短期对比符合汇集长期经验的参考。

blocks.en: The dates on which new top-rated models first appeared on Arena show mixed co-movements (Appendix Table 9 ). The arrival of gpt-4o-2024-05-13 coincides with a jump of 5.0 points and that of gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 with a fall of 1.3 points; the largest change coincides with the traffic surge of 7 August 2024. The monthly path in Figure 1 (b) climbs in most months, including months without such arrivals. The average rating of the models in that month’s battles is closely associated with the harsher verdicts (7.32 points per 100 rating points). It rises almost in a straight line with calendar time (correlation .99), so this association and the monthly trend describe the same steady climb.
blocks.zh: 新的顶级模型首次出现在阿雷纳上的日期显示混合相动(附录表9). gpt-4o-2024-05-13的到来与5.0分的跳出和gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09相接并相接而来,跌出1.3分;最大的变化与2024年8月7日的交通猛增相接. 图1(b)中的月度路径在大多数月中攀升,包括没有这种到达的月。 当月的战斗中,模型的平均评分与更严厉的判决(每100分7.32分)密切相关. 它几乎以直线与日历时间相接而起(correlation.99),因此这种关联和月度趋势描述了同样的平稳攀升.

blocks.en: 5.7 A shared drift that frozen references can remove
blocks.zh: 5.7 (中文(简体) ). 共享的被冻结的引用可以去除

blocks.en: The last test asks whether the drift is shared across models, and whether it can be removed out of sample (Figure 6 ). Of the eighteen frozen models with enough votes, seventeen show a significant rise in “both are bad” on their own pairs, with an average trend of + + 1.40 points a month. A platform that tracked the acceptance of each fixed model separately would conclude that seventeen of these models had become worse. After subtracting month effects estimated only from frozen pairs that do not involve the model, the average trend is + + 0.19 points a month; three models keep a significantly positive trend and one a significantly negative one. The drift on any one model’s pairs is predicted by the drift on the other models’ pairs. The drift is therefore a shift common to the evaluations rather than a set of separate changes in individual models, and a reference set of frozen pairs measured in the same period is enough to remove it.
blocks.zh: 最后一项测试询问漂移是否跨模型共享,是否可以从样本中取出(图6.). 在拥有足够票数的十八个被冻结的型号中,17个型号显示自己一对型号上的"两者都不好"大幅上升,平均每月有++1.40分的趋势. 一个单独跟踪每个固定模型被接受情况的平台将得出结论,其中17个模型已经变得更糟. 减去仅从不涉及模型的冷冻对子中估计的月份影响后,平均趋势是++0.19分;有三种模型保持显著正向趋势,有一种是显著负向趋势. 任何一个模型的对子的漂移是由其他模型的对子所预测的. 因此,漂移是评价中常见的转变,而不是单个模型的一组单独变化,在同一期间所测量的一组冷冻对子的参考值足以去除.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: For more than a year, voters on Chatbot Arena judged unchanged AI models more harshly month after month. In 2024, when they chose between two answers, they chose the stronger model about as often at the end as at the start. What moved was how often neither answer was good enough, and it moved within the same voters, on the same pairs, and across cohorts of newcomers. Measured changes in prompts, in the serving of the models and in the interface do not account for it, and the drift on each model’s pairs is predicted by the drift on the others’. On the platform as a whole, the models improved greatly while the share of answers rejected as “both are bad” ended near where it started.
blocks.zh: 在一年多的时间里,查特博特竞技场的选民们逐月地更严厉地判断AI模型没有改变. 2024年,当他们选择两个答案之间时,他们选择了最强的模型,在结尾和开头一样频繁. 令人感动的是,往往两个答案都不够好,它在同一选民中移动,在同一对选民中移动,并跨出一批新人。 在提示、模型的功能和界面中测量到的变化并不反映这一点,每个模型的对子上漂移的预测是通过其他模型的漂移来进行的。 在整个平台上,这些模型大有改进,而因“两者都是坏的”而被否决的答案比例则接近其起点。

blocks.en: 6.1 Theoretical implications
blocks.zh: 6.1 理论影响

blocks.en: Evaluations that move while the system stands still. Continuance research models expectations about a focal system and follows how they change with use of that system ( Bhattacherjee, 2001 ; Bhattacherjee and Premkumar, 2004 ; Kim and Malhotra, 2005 ) . Our evidence shows evaluations of fixed systems changing for reasons outside the systems. Verdicts became harsher within voters, and voters who arrived later were harsher from their first recorded vote, although nothing about the systems had changed. Adaptation-level theory accounts for this pattern with a reference formed by experience across a category ( Helson, 1964 ; Parducci, 1965 ) : as the category improves, the standard against which a system is judged rises, so evaluations of a system that stands still decline. Expectation-confirmation models of fast-moving technologies can incorporate this account by letting the expectation term depend on exposure to other systems in the category, with boundary conditions such as how substitutable the systems are and how visible the category’s progress is.
blocks.zh: 评估在系统保持不变的同时进行。 持续研究模型对一个协调系统的期望,并跟踪这些模型如何随着该系统的使用而变化(Bhatacherjee,2001年;Bhatacherjee和Premkumar,2004年;Kim和Malhotra,2005年)。 我们的证据表明,对固定系统因系统之外的原因而改变的评价。 判决在选民内部变得更加严厉,后来到达的选民在第一次有记录的投票中更加严厉,尽管关于制度方面没有任何变化. 适应级理论用一个跨类别的经验形成的参考(Helson,1964;Parducci,1965)来解释这个模式: 随着类别改善,判断一个系统的标准上升了,所以对一个系统的评价仍然在下降. 快速移动技术的预期确认模型可以通过让预期术语取决于接触该类别中的其他系统而纳入这一账户,其边界条件包括这些系统可如何替代以及该类别的进展如何明显。

blocks.en: A rater-side source of declining ratings. Declining ratings for a fixed product are usually explained by changes in who rates ( Li and Hitt, 2008 ; Godes and Silva, 2012 ; Moe and Schweidel, 2012 ) . Our design holds both the product and the voter identifier fixed and still finds decline, so the drift of each rater’s standard is a separate mechanism. It implies that ratings of unchanged products should fall fastest in categories where quality improves fastest, a prediction that can be tested in any rating system.
blocks.zh: 评分率下降的源头 固定产品的收视率下降通常由谁的收视率变化来解释(Li and Hitt, 2008; Godes and Silva, 2012;Moe and Schweidel, 2012.). 我们的设计既固定了产品,也固定了选民身份标识,但仍然发现下降,因此,每个评定员的标准漂移是一个单独的机制。 这意味着,在质量改善最快的类别中,对未改变产品评级的速度应快一些,这种预测可以在任何评级系统中测试。

blocks.en: Absolute and relative judgments of AI. The split between a stable ranking and a drifting bar is what work on comparative and absolute judgment predicts ( Thurstone, 1927 ; Parducci, 1965 ; Stewart et al., 2005 ) . It mirrors, in reverse, reputation inflation on online platforms, where the meaning of a fixed score drifts upward ( Filippas et al., 2022 ) . For AI, the meaning of “acceptable” drifted the other way.
blocks.zh: 大赦国际的绝对和相对判决。 稳定排名和漂流条之间的分出是比较判断和绝对判断的预期(Thurstone,1927;Parducci,1965;Stewart等,2005.). 它反之反映了网络平台上的名声膨胀,固定分数的含义向上飘去(Filippas等,2022年). 大赦国际认为,“可接受”的含义是相反的。

blocks.en: 6.2 Practical implications
blocks.zh: 6.2 实际影响

blocks.en: For AI providers. Complaints that a model “got worse” can arise when nothing about the model changed. A provider that keeps a model fixed should expect evaluations of it to fall as the rest of the market improves: on Arena, the share of outright rejections of fixed pairs rose at an annualized historical rate of about 21 percentage points on a base of 17.1 %. Separating a real change in a product from rising standards requires a fixed reference evaluated alongside the product over time.
blocks.zh: 为AI提供商. 抱怨说,当模型没有任何变化时,可能会出现“恶化”的模式。 拥有固定模型的供应商应该期望随着市场其他部分的改善而降低对模型的评价:在阿雷纳,固定对子的彻底拒绝比例以每年约21个百分点的历史增长率上升,基数为17.1%。 将产品与不断提高的标准区分开来,需要长期与产品一起评估的固定参考。

blocks.en: For evaluation platforms and leaderboards. Absolute verdicts such as “both are bad” are not comparable across periods without adjustment. Platforms can keep frozen reference models in the evaluation mix, as Arena did by accident, and use them to re-anchor absolute measures, in the spirit of re-anchoring rating scales ( Garg and Johari, 2021 ) . Our out-of-sample test shows that this removes the drift from models whose pairs were not used to estimate it. The result suggests a simple design principle for evaluation systems of fast-moving technologies: keep a reference set of fixed items in the evaluation stream, estimate period effects on that set, and report absolute measures net of those effects alongside the raw measures. Frozen models still meet new prompts; fixed prompt–answer pairs would hold the task fixed as well and so offer a stricter anchor. Asking for a forced choice and a separate acceptability judgment on every comparison would record both quantities directly. On Arena, the relative verdicts that drive the rankings showed no trend in 2024 while the absolute ones drifted. Not all drift should be removed: if users’ needs have genuinely risen, a current measure of satisfaction should reflect that, so platforms gain most from reporting both a fixed-standard measure and a current one.
blocks.zh: 为评价平台和领导板. 诸如“两者都是坏的”等绝对判决,在不进行调整的情况下,是无法相互比较的。 平台可以在评价组合中保留被冻结的参考模型,就像Arena偶然做的一样,并本着重新确定评分等级(Garg and Johari, 2021.)的精神,用它们来重新确定绝对度量. 我们的外样本测试显示,这可以消除那些没有用对子来估计的模型的漂移. 结果为快速移动技术评价系统提出了简单的设计原则:在评价流程中保留一套固定项目的参考,估计对这套技术的期间影响,并报告除这些影响外的绝对措施。 冷冻模型仍然会遇到新的提示;固定的即时回答对将同样承担固定的任务,从而提供一个更严格的锚地。 要求强制选择和对每一项比较分别作出可接受性判断将直接记录这两个数量。 在阿雷纳,驱动排名的相对判决在2024年没有显示出任何趋势,而绝对数则漂移. 并不是所有的漂移都应该去掉:如果用户的需求真正增加,目前的满意度衡量标准应该反映出这一点,因此,平台从汇报固定标准和当前标准衡量标准中得益最大。

blocks.en: For human feedback in training. Preference data used to train models mix relative choices with absolute judgments of acceptability ( Christiano et al., 2017 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . Our results imply that absolute labels carry a time stamp: a response of a given quality that was accepted in 2023 would be more likely to be rejected by a comparable voter in 2024. Pipelines that pool absolute labels across periods, or use them to set a fixed quality threshold, mix different standards. Whether that helps, by tracking what users now want, or hurts, by adding noise to a fixed target, depends on the purpose of the label.
blocks.zh: 用于训练中的人类反馈. 用于训练模型的偏好数据将相对选择与可接受性的绝对判断相混合(Christiano等,2017;Ouyang等,2022.). 我们的结果意味着绝对标签带有时间戳:2023年接受的某一质量的答复,在2024年更有可能被可比选民拒绝。 管道可以将绝对标签汇集到不同时期,或者用来设定固定的质量阈值,混合不同的标准. 无论是通过跟踪用户现在想要什么,还是通过在固定目标上添加噪声来帮助,取决于标签的目的.

blocks.en: 6.3 Limitations and future work
blocks.zh: 6.3 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: The first set of limits concerns who is observed. Arena’s voters are a self-selected public interested in comparing AI, so the size of the drift in the general population is a question for future work, for example with panels that ask the same people to rate fixed answers at intervals. The judge identifier follows a device or network rather than a person, the log covers only voters who chose to vote, and the previous-battle test conditions on voters who returned. Later arrival cohorts may differ in who they are as well as in what they have experienced.
blocks.zh: 第一组限制涉及谁被观察到。 Arena的选民是一对比较AI感兴趣的自选公众,因此一般人群中漂移的大小是未来工作的一个问题,例如与要求同一人每隔一段时间对固定答案进行评分的小组. 法官身份识别符遵循的是设备或网络而非个人,日志只涵盖选择投票的选民,以及此前对返回的选民的战斗测试条件. 后来抵达的人群可能因身份和经历而异。

blocks.en: The second set concerns what the log records. It contains no prompt or answer text and no prompt key, so the high-frequency subset does not hold the mix of prompts fixed; text releases covering parts of the period would allow comparisons of verdicts on identical prompts and on the answers themselves. The interface tests rely on commit dates, which can differ from deployment dates, and the arrival dates of new models mark first appearances on Arena rather than measured exposure. The relative verdict is a pooled share, which can hide offsetting changes in individual pairs, and the intervals for the fourteen long-observed pairs treat pairs and votes as independent.
blocks.zh: 第二套涉及日志记录的内容。 它不包含即时或应答文本,也不包含即时键,因此高频子集不持有即时键的组合固定;覆盖期间部分时间的文本发布可以比较相同即时键和答案本身的判断. 界面测试依赖于承诺日期,它可能与部署日期不同,而新模型的到来日期标记了首次在阿雷纳出现而不是被测量的暴露. 相对判断是集合分享,可以隐藏单个对子的抵消变化,十四对被长期观察的对子的间隔将对子和选票视为独立.

blocks.en: The third set concerns the mechanism. The data locate the change in the judges but do not record each voter’s exposure to other AI systems. Because the average quality of the models on Arena rose almost in step with calendar time, the data also cannot separate it from other influences that grew over the same months, and the vote cannot separate a higher threshold from closer scrutiny. Linking verdicts to measured exposure, and using answers with known flaws to separate the two components, are the next steps. The most direct test is an experiment that exposes people to stronger or weaker AI on matched tasks and then has them rate the same saved answer pairs. Recording a forced choice and an acceptability judgment for each answer, with a delayed follow-up, would show both the size of the effect and how long it lasts. Finally, the period ends in August 2024. Whether standards keep rising at the same pace, or level off as improvement slows, can be tracked as new frozen models accumulate on evaluation platforms.
blocks.zh: 第三套涉及机制。 数据查找法官的变动,但没有记录每个选民接触其他人工智能系统的情况。 由于阿雷纳岛上模型的平均质量几乎随日历时间而上升,因此数据也无法将其与同期增长的其他影响区分开来,而投票也无法将更高的门槛与更仔细的审查分开来. 接下来的步骤是将判决与测量的接触联系起来,并利用已知缺陷的答案将这两个组成部分分开。 最直接的测试是一种实验,它让人们在匹配的任务上接触到更强或更弱的AI,然后让他们对相同的被保存的回答对进行评分. 记录每个答案的强制选择和可接受判断,加上延迟的后续,将显示效果的大小和持续时间。 最后,这一时期于2024年8月结束. 随着新的被冻结模式在评价平台上累积,无论是以同样的速度不断提高标准,还是随着改进速度缓慢而逐步降低标准,都可以加以跟踪。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Organizations read human evaluations of AI as evidence about the systems being evaluated. This paper shows that the evaluations themselves move. Our three questions have clear answers. On Chatbot Arena, verdicts on unchanged models became steadily harsher from 2023 to 2024. The change sat in the absolute judgment rather than the relative one, and it appeared within raters and across arrival cohorts rather than only through a changing pool. And because the drift was shared across models, frozen references measured in the same period removed it. For a technology that improves as quickly as generative AI, a product that stands still is judged as declining, and evaluation systems that separate the product from the standard applied to it give a truer picture of both.
blocks.zh: 各组织将人类对AI的评价视为评价系统的证据。 本文表明,评价本身正在移动。 我们的三个问题都有明确的答案。 在查特博特竞技场上,从2023年到2024年,对不变型号的判决逐渐变得更加严厉. 变化在于绝对判断,而不是相对判断,它出现在评估者和抵达群体之间,而不是仅仅通过不断变化的池子出现。 并且由于漂移是跨模型共享的,在同一时期测量到的被冻结的引用去除. 对于像基因AI那样快速改进的技术,仍然站着的产品被判断为衰落,而将产品与应用的标准相分离的评价系统则给出了更真实的两种情况.

The largest, on 7 August 2024, coincides with a surge in traffic in the last week of the log, when daily battles rose from about 5,808 to 7,511; the main estimate without that week is + + 1.56 points a month.

blocks.en: Table 10 reports the coefficient-stability calculations of Oster (2019) for the main trend. The uncontrolled estimate is + + 1.71 points a month with within-pair R 2 R^{2} 0.001; with prompt-content and conversation controls it is + + 1.57 with within-pair R 2 R^{2} 0.020. Under proportional selection, δ \delta is the ratio of selection on unobserved to selection on observed controls that would bring the trend to zero, given an assumed maximum R 2 R^{2} that a full set of controls could reach; the last column is the bias-adjusted trend when δ = 1 \delta=1 . The calculation uses the linear approximation in Oster’s paper on the within-pair (pair-demeaned) data. The rows for prompt content only exclude the conversation controls, which can depend on earlier answers. The outcome is an individual binary vote, so even a complete set of prompt controls would leave most of its variation unexplained; the table shows how the conclusion changes as the assumed maximum rises.
